tools.name: stage_physics
tools.description: Stage a physics patch with a nonempty EvidenceRef list for each changed engineering input, keyed by JSON Pointer relative to physics. Each supplied field replaces the matching draft field. Requires the active writer lease, epoch and matching revisions. Apply via the existing fingerprint-bound human review and commit flow.

tools.name: import_mic_matrix
tools.description: Validate the MIC JSON and its part reference. Atomically stage the MIC attachment, its SHA-256 and EvidenceRef citations, and set physics.micMatrixRef to the attachment ID. Requires the active writer lease, epoch and matching revisions. Apply via the existing fingerprint-bound human review and commit flow.

MicMatrixPayloadV1.description: The runtime parser must reject non-finite numbers and enforce one matrix row per measurement point and one column per control point.

tools.name: analyze_compliant_stackup
tools.description: Analyze the leased draft using explicit Monte Carlo settings. Use the same samples for the rigid and compliant calculations. Optional What-If inputs affect the trial only. Results are advisory and do not approve or commit any revision.
